notes: C++ is now a full beginner-to-pro course: 84 lessons (was 66), targeting C++23 with GCC 16.
New deep-dive lessons: files and std::filesystem, std::expected and dates with chrono, and modern C++ (std::print, modules).
New advanced lessons: coroutines and std::generator, deadlocks and lock ordering, wrapping a C library, secure parsing with sanitizers, custom allocators, and variadic templates.

A new "Working like a pro" unit: CMake targets, linking and the ODR, vcpkg and Conan, headers and project layout, clang-tidy and clang-format, CI, command-line tools, and shipping with semver and ABI stability.
Every C++ exercise has wrong answers its tests reject, every lesson a Common mistakes note, and the capstones milestones.
